entities.summary: Leopoldo Ndakalako is an Angolan Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Menongue, in Angola, since 19 March 2019. Before that, from 14 December 1997, he was a priest of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Ondjiva, Angola. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated bishop on 12 May 2019 at Ondjiva. He was installed at Menongue on 26 May 2019.
